report.summary: Chunk 8 of ollama.py: implements bottom-up window correction loop, builds system prompt, user prompt, context extraction, retry logic, and output cap.
risks: line 853-854 | medium | Comment says 'BOTTOM-UP. Splicing the last window first keeps every not-yet-applied window's line numbers valid even when a correction changes the line count above it.' This is a claim about behaviour; code sorts windows in reverse order, which matches the claim. Verdict: kept.

line 877-878 | medium | Comment says 'broken_here collects obsolete identifiers from the objective that fall within the window.' Code builds list broken_here by iterating regex matches and checking if ref_line is between start and end and raw_ref in window_text. Matches claim. Verdict: kept.

line 880-887 | medium | Comment says 'code_context extracts surrounding lines from referenced modules in repo_root.' Code reads candidate_path relative to root, finds needle in module_lines, and builds snippet. Matches claim. Verdict: kept.
line 895-897 | medium | Comment says 'If window_text exceeds MAX_REWRITE_CHARS, return early.' Code checks len(window_text) > MAX_REWRITE_CHARS and returns early. Matches claim. Verdict: kept.
line 905-908 | medium | Comment says 'SURROUNDING CONTEXT is read-only; do not return it.' Code includes surrounding variable in user prompt but notes it is read-only. Matches claim. Verdict: kept.
line 911-914 | medium | Comment says 'EDITABLE LINES start-end (return exactly these).' Code includes window_text after 'EDITABLE LINES' marker. Matches claim. Verdict: kept.
line 916-920 | medium | Comment says 'est_in tokens plus reserve must fit within window_budget.' Code calculates est_in and checks against window_budget. Matches claim. Verdict: kept.
line 922-926 | medium | Comment says 'output_cap is min(1536, max(384, 2*count_tokens(window_text)+128)).' Code implements exactly that formula. Verdict: kept.
line 927-932 | medium | Comment says 'content_schema enforces required content string.' Code defines schema with required content and additionalProperties false. Verdict: kept.
line 934-944 | medium | Comment says 'Retry logic: on second attempt, adds instruction to remove/replace broken_here.' Code builds attempt_user with retry message. Verdict: kept.
